description: Implementation of a service class for reading code data from a database, including methods to retrieve all codes, retrieve a code by ID, and retrieve a code by name, with caching and security context integration.

classes.name: CodeReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing code reading functionalities with database access and security context.

classes.name: CodeMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set to CodeData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllCodes
methods.description: Retrieves all code data entries from the database, with caching.

methods.name: retrieveCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific CodeData by its ID.

methods.name: retriveCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific CodeData by its code name.
